concept: A single identity pulse travels through a clean Microsoft sign-in system, splitting into two routes and becoming stronger when a second factor closes the circuit.

palette.assetRule: Official Microsoft service icons retain their supplied colors.

motionSignature.name: Verified passage
rules: elements enter on a thin travelling pulse
tiles settle without overshoot after a short 12px rise
verification uses one restrained close or check motion rather than repeated bouncing

composition.grammar: center-weighted modular diagrams with large quiet margins
rules: Do not place small labels, kickers, scene names, or metadata in either top corner.
Use one approved source icon per concept; never duplicate icons for symmetry or combine multiple icons into one concept marker.
Responsive icon variant sheets are source material only; extract the largest or highest-resolution approved glyph, usually the bottommost filled variant, and never place the full sheet in a scene.
Use one strong main title without a subtitle directly underneath; supporting explanation belongs in narration or the primary visual.
Keep supporting distinctions in the diagram structure or primary copy, not in decorative micro-text.

signatureMotif: A thin sign-in pulse connects scene transitions and owns only the opening junction and MFA close.
referenceDirection: Kelly sample: light field, pale-blue tiles, progressive concept assembly
Microsoft Fluent clarity with restrained editorial scale
